globalDeclarations.name: compact_rpow_le_eight
globalDeclarations.head:
private theorem compact_rpow_le_eight
    (p z : ℝ) (hp2 : 2 < p) (hp3 : p ≤ 3)
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1) :
    Real.rpow (1 + z) p ≤ 8

globalDeclarations.name: actual_original_compact_pmoment_cost
globalDeclarations.head:
theorem actual_original_compact_pmoment_cost
    {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o y, h o y = h y o)
    (hcenter : (∫ t : Ω × Ω, h t.1 t.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ y, h o y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (p : ℝ) (hp2 : 2 < p) (hp3 : p ≤ 3)
    (hgp : Integrable (fun o => Real.rpow |∫ y, h o y ∂μ| p) μ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ y, h o y ∂μ
    let β : ℝ := ∫ o, Real.rpow |g o| p ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
    let v : ℝ := ∫ t : Ω × Ω, r t.1 t.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let rho : ℝ := Real.sqrt v
    let sigma : ℝ := 1 + rho
    let N : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let P₀ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)
    let projectionTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Shao.truncationF ((1 + z) * (g (ξ i) / N))
    let Lcompact : ℝ :=
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ ξ, projectionTest ξ i ∂P₀
    let cap : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      min (|g (ξ i)| / N) (1 / (1 + z))
    let D : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ :=
      Shao.OQ5.P51.residualStatisticD n r
    let Ddel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ :=
      Shao.OQ5.P51.residualStatisticDDeleted n r
    let J : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ :=
      Shao.OQ5.P51.residualEnergyJ n r
    let Jdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ :=
      Shao.OQ5.P51.residualEnergyJDeleted n r
    let A : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => |D ξ|
    let Adel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => |Ddel ξ i|
    let B₁ : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ :=
      Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClipBudget n r C₀ rho 1
    let B₁del : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ :=
      Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClipBudgetDeleted n r C₀ rho 1
    let deletedTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      cap ξ i * (|A ξ - Adel ξ i| + z * |B₁ ξ - B₁del ξ i|)
    let residualFee : ℝ :=
      (∫ ξ, A ξ ∂P₀) + z * (∫ ξ, B₁ ξ ∂P₀) +
        ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ ξ, deletedTest ξ i ∂P₀
    let sourceCost : ℝ := Lcompact + residualFee
    (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => projectionTest ξ i) P₀) ∧
      Lcompact = (n : ℝ) *
        (∫ o, Shao.truncationF ((1 + z) * (g o / N)) ∂μ) ∧
      0 ≤ Lcompact ∧
      Lcompact ≤ (1 + z) ^ 2 ∧
      Lcompact ≤ 4 ∧
      (∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω,
        B₁ ξ = C₀ * (sigma / N + J ξ / (sigma * N))) ∧
      (∀ (ξ : Fin n → Ω) (i : Fin n),
        B₁del ξ i = C₀ * (sigma / N + Jdel ξ i / (sigma * N))) ∧
      Integrable A P₀ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => Adel ξ i) P₀) ∧
      Integrable B₁ P₀ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => B₁del ξ i) P₀) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => cap ξ i * |A ξ - Adel ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => cap ξ i * |B₁ ξ - B₁del ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => deletedTest ξ i) P₀) ∧
      residualFee ≤
        128 * (1 + C₀) * (1 + rho + rho ^ 2) / N ∧
      sourceCost ≤ Lcompact +
        128 * (1 + C₀) * (1 + rho + rho ^ 2) / N ∧
      0 ≤ β ∧
      Integrable (fun o => Shao.truncationF ((1 + z) * (g o / N))) μ ∧
      Lcompact ≤ β * Real.rpow (1 + z) p /
        Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((p - 2) / 2) ∧
      Lcompact ≤ 8 * β / Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((p - 2) / 2) ∧
      sourceCost ≤ 8 * β / Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((p - 2) / 2) +
        128 * (1 + C₀) * (1 + rho + rho ^ 2) / N

## All public non-Prop lets and exact permitted mirrors

These are the complete22 public data templates, in dependency order. All21 original216 templates are retained with exactly the same types and values; β is the only new template. If a future authorized proof mirrors any of them, the displayed type and value are mandatory. This is not authorization to mirror or implement now.

```lean

β : ℝ := ∫ o, Real.rpow |g o| p ∂μ
r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
v : ℝ := ∫ t : Ω × Ω, r t.1 t.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)

N : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
P₀ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)
projectionTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
  Shao.truncationF ((1 + z) * (g (ξ i) / N))

cap : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>

  Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClipBudget n r C₀ rho 1

  Shao.OQ5.P51.studentizerClipBudgetDeleted n r C₀ rho 1

  cap ξ i * (|A ξ - Adel ξ i| + z * |B₁ ξ - B₁del ξ i|)
```

The proposed helper has zero local lets. The public proof has zero additional planned non-Prop aliases beyond exact mirrors of those22 templates. In particular it does not recreate140's tilted laws/densities,170's scalar-normalization aliases, or216's kappa/Cprime/delta/row-sum assembly. Imported theorem application facts and projections are Prop-valued; any proposed non-Prop choice, new function, auxiliary datum or helper requires a prior parent ledger amendment. Function/lambda-bound ξ, i, o, y are bound arguments of the displayed templates, not free captures.

## Global values and instances

- New global `def`, `abbrev`, structure, inductive, opaque/non-theorem constant, local notation and user-defined instance: zero. All new owned source declarations are theorem heads only.
- No ambient section variables are proposed; both heads bind every needed argument. `set_option autoImplicit false` prevents accidental implicit model parameters.
- Product measurable spaces on Ω×Ω and finite-product measurable spaces on Fin n→Ω are the canonical imported instances determined by the single public MeasurableSpace Ω. Real's measurable/topological/normed/ring/lattice/integral structures are canonical Mathlib instances; none is an extra parameter or override.
- Fin n uses its canonical Fintype and decidable-equality/order structures. There is no alternate index space, external enumeration, retained law or measurable selector.
- `[IsProbabilityMeasure μ]` is the explicit Prop instance. If a later proof needs `IsProbabilityMeasure P₀`, its complete type is `MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ))`; its intended value is the canonical existing finite-product probability instance inferred from the public input. This is a derived Prop instance/fact, not a new measure or non-Prop override. No additional instance is proposed.
- A `classical` scope uses canonical imported classical decidability only. No `Classical.choose` datum or selector is planned. The allowed transitive axiom whitelist remains propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; no actual217 axiom result exists at stage1.
- `noncomputable section` is proposed for real integrals and existing data expressions. It grants no unsafe execution or new axiom.

## Captures of the22 templates

`g` captures Ω, its measurable-space instance, μ and h. `β` additionally captures p through g. `r` uses h and g; v uses r, μ and the canonical product measurable space; rho/sigma/N use only earlier listed values and n. P₀ uses Ω, its measurable-space instance, μ and the original n. ProjectionTest/Lcompact/cap additionally use z and g/N. D/Ddel/J/Jdel use n and r. A/Adel use their named D/Ddel; B₁/B₁del additionally use C₀ and rho, at literal last parameter1. deletedTest uses cap,A,Adel,z,B₁,B₁del. residualFee uses P₀,A,z,B₁,deletedTest. sourceCost is literally Lcompact+residualFee. No proof of integrability is captured as non-Prop data.

The hgp input and β expression agree definitionally after unfolding g. The helper170's N=(n:ℝ), q=sqrt(N) must not be confused with217's N=sqrt(n:ℝ). The consumer uses Real.rpow for both `(1+z)^p` and `n^((p−2)/2)`; `rho ^ 2` is the natural square already used by216. No norm, moment or denominator is silently exchanged.
